system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Blue Spirit abilities, and you must be specially favored by the Blue Spirit

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

The Blue Spirit has rewarded you with great and terrible power in exchange for your service.

As an Action, you may partially transform into a spirit of thought and magic, granting yourself incredible arcane power.

  • Your Mind and Soul increase by +2.

  • You gain a Fly Speed of 5. If you already have a Fly Speed, it increases by +5.

  • Once per turn, when you successfully cast a spell, you may immediately cast a second spell as a Free Action. The Complexity of the second spell increases by +1.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, most mages, scholars, and other followers of the Blue Spirit will recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
